column1: # Every write to an object's translation row (effective offset +0x50), classified.
# read-only, against the non-canonical Xenon import. No oracle.
# kind: stack      - the base is r1; a local, not an object
#       copy       - the vector was loaded from memory: a transfer
#       computed   - the vector came out of vector arithmetic
#       unresolved - the source is outside a 14-instruction window
# Not one site in the mission cluster 0x822xxxxx authors a position from
# data: they copy one or compose one.
# BUT THIS LIST IS NOT EXHAUSTIVE, and cycle 1133 measured by how much. The
# scan sees stvx128 with a resolvable index and stfs with a literal
# displacement. It is blind to indexed stores, of which the binary has 1018:
# stfsx 552, stvlx 218, stvewx 194, stvrx 54. A position written by stfsx with
# a computed displacement passes under both scans.
